{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma1

|version3= 1.50

|game4= tkoh
|version4= 1.00

|game5= arma3
|version5= 0.50

|gr1= GUI Control - Map

|descr= Draw a line on the map. Can decrease framerate!

|s1= map [[drawLine]] [from, to, color, width]

|p1= map: [[Control]]

|p2= from: [[Object]] or [[Position#Introduction|Position2D]] or [[Position#Introduction|Position3D]]

|p3= to: [[Object]] or [[Position#Introduction|Position2D]] or [[Position#Introduction|Position3D]]

|p4= color: [[Color|Color (RGBA)]]

|p5= width: [[Number]] - (Optional, default 3)
|p5since= arma3 2.18

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>
(findDisplay 12 displayCtrl 51) ctrlAddEventHandler ["Draw",
	"(_this select 0) drawLine [
		player,
		[0,0,0],
		[0,0,1,1]
	];"
];
</sqf>

{{GVI|arma3|2.02}} [[toString]] version:
<sqf>
(findDisplay 12 displayCtrl 51) ctrlAddEventHandler ["Draw", toString {
	(_this select 0) drawLine [
		player,
		[0,0,0],
		[0,0,1,1] // blue
	];
}];
</sqf>
